peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (10.7): 1.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 26 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 5). Context, not scored: resales in 8.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Bright Hill MRT about 820 m, Mayflower MRT about 930 m; closer than 83 of 462 similar developments (the same as 3). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Ai Tong School about 1,130 m; more than 0 of 462 similar developments (the same as 58). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 440 m), more than 56 of 462 similar developments (the same as 149); nearest hawker centre Jalan Leban Food Centre about 330 m; nearest park Central Catchment Nature Reserve about 90 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming: Teck Ghee MRT (Cross Island Line) about 1,670 m, under construction; LTA target 2030. Straight-line distance to the planned station site; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 6 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Lentoria, 27 new sales, about 1,570 m; Lentor Mansion, 2 new sales, about 1,630 m; Lentor Gardens Residences, 299 new sales, about 1,750 m; Hillock Green, 15 new sales, about 1,850 m; Lentor Central Residences, 1 new sales, about 1,880 m; Artisan 8, 4 new sales, about 1,970 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 32 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 348 new sales and 188 resales (536 purchases); new sales were 64.9% of these purchases. Subsales (102) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Thomson Reserve development, about 1,420 m; Lentor Central GLS site (Mar 2026) (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,990 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 188 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 19 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 188 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 216 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−13%). Planning-area private resales +12.2%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
